name: 会话归档
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="5" rx="1.5"/><path d="M5 9v10a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9"/><path d="M10 13h4"/></svg>
description: 左栏会话行里的归档按钮：点一下把对话从侧边栏收起来，**不删任何文件、不申请目录授权**。可设 1/7/30 天或永不；到期默认只标记（需要你点“删除”才真删）。附归档管理面板：恢复 / 改期 / 手动删除。
descriptionEn: Archive button inside each sidebar conversation row: hide a chat without deleting anything or requesting directory access. Optional 1/7/30-day or never expiry; on expiry it only marks the entry, and the file is deleted only when you explicitly confirm. Ships a management panel to restore, re-schedule or delete.

settings.label: 默认保留天数
settings.hint: 归档时直接使用的天数（点 🗄 立即归档，不再弹窗）；0 表示永不到期。

settings.label: 当前打开的对话也显示归档按钮
settings.labelEn: Show the archive button on the active row

settings.label: 到期自动删除会话文件
settings.labelEn: Delete the session file automatically on expiry
settings.hint: 默认关闭：到期只标记“已到期”，文件不动。开启后也只在已授权会话目录时才删，不会弹授权框。

leftpanel.projects.actions.hint: 会话归档：查看已归档的对话，恢复 / 改期 / 立即删除
leftpanel.projects.actions.hintEn: Session archive: restore, re-schedule or purge archived chats
